nodes.label: D-01 Integrate with Kiro, don't just code with Kiro
nodes.rationale: Judging scores how effectively Kiro is used; product input is a Kiro spec, outputs land in spec folder, driven via MCP, hook, steering, Power

nodes.label: D-03 LLM compiles to constrained JSON DSL; deterministic running
nodes.rationale: Free-form generated Playwright code is flaky, unvalidatable, executes arbitrary code and looks like an attack script request

nodes.label: D-04 Input payloads from deterministic generators, never LLM
nodes.rationale: Reproducibility, no refusals, no need to review LLM-invented values

nodes.label: D-05 Host allowlist defaults to localhost, can't widen from steering
nodes.rationale: Prevents misuse against third-party sites

nodes.label: D-06 Verdicts need reproduction (ceil(2N/3) of N=3)
nodes.rationale: A red mark has to be trustworthy for the video and for Kiro's agent

nodes.label: D-07 Concurrency capped (default 12, max 20)
nodes.rationale: Not a load tester; 12 tiles readable at 1080p

nodes.label: D-08 QA tool, not a security scanner
nodes.rationale: No exploit generation; F25 scrapped

nodes.label: D-09 Plain QA wording in prompts
nodes.rationale: Reduces refusals and watered-down output, helps plan quality

nodes.label: D-10 Candy Swap built honestly, no planted bugs
nodes.rationale: Judges probe whether a demo is staged

nodes.label: D-11 Stack: TS/Node 22, Playwright, zod, Claude, Vite+React
nodes.rationale: Matches Reanimator; every critical library is TypeScript-first

nodes.label: D-12 Static replay on Vercel; AWS only as Bedrock provider
D-13 Personas are a fixed built-in set
nodes.rationale: Keeps scope down; persona quality matters more than quantity

nodes.label: D-14 Reports written into spec folder; spec files never edited
nodes.rationale: Kiro's agent reads the spec folder; user keeps ownership of their spec

nodes.label: D-15 Targets by role, label, text or test id
nodes.rationale: More stable than CSS, readable, compiler cannot invent selectors

nodes.label: D-16 Criterion identity (N.M IDs, content hash) and EARS parsing
nodes.rationale: Plan cache keys on hash so inserting criteria never invalidates plans

nodes.label: D-18 Network guard dead-proxy backstop and WebRTC block
nodes.rationale: context.route never sees redirect hops; WebRTC STUN UDP bypasses HTTP guards

nodes.label: D-19 One health gate: npm run health
nodes.rationale: Single definition of green so no regressions slip in

nodes.label: D-22 Guard reports hidden redirect hops with reason redirect
nodes.rationale: Under CPU load Chromium surfaces a stopped hop only as original request failure

nodes.label: D-24 The costume is a haunted terminal
nodes.rationale: ASCII glyphs via Bayer dither; ectoplasm green for ghosts only; distinct from Reanimator

nodes.label: D-25 Fresh start in new repo, rebuilt from docs
nodes.rationale: 2026 rules reportedly count only new projects

nodes.label: D-26 Costume Kit is its own package (F26)
nodes.rationale: CLI, report and Seance must share one look without depending on each other

nodes.label: D-27 Spec Reader edge cases and API (F01)
D-28 main protected by GitHub ruleset; PRs only
D-31 F04 persona and generator rulings
D-32 F05 compiler rulings
nodes.rationale: Deterministic keyword-overlap route picker; no literal input; cache key includes persona hash

nodes.label: D-33 F06 runner rulings
nodes.rationale: Conflict-key scheduling instead of seed partitioning since partitioning needs app cooperation

nodes.label: D-37 F10 prep rulings (Kiro builds Candy Swap)
D-38 F11 MCP server rulings (long-poll, five tools)
nodes.rationale: Kiro requestTimeout reportedly 120 s so no call outlives it

nodes.label: D-39 Poltergeist is the headless engine inside Reanimator
nodes.rationale: Team merged Poltergeist with Reanimator into one Frankenstein entry

nodes.label: D-40 F12 becomes headless Live Feed
D-41 F13 Kiro installer (poltergeist init)
nodes.rationale: Reanimator's R5 heal loop needs Kiro to get Poltergeist's MCP tools, steering and hook

nodes.label: D-42 F14 re-haunt rulings (merge and diff)
D-44 F16 Lich & Revenant: device presets, usable failures
nodes.rationale: Control run rejected: needs mid-rep reset which breaks concurrent pairs

nodes.label: D-45 F17 house rules from steering
D-46 F18 Kiro Power packaging
nodes.rationale: A Power is another first-class Kiro integration judged under how well Kiro is used

nodes.label: D-47 F19 Amazon Bedrock provider
nodes.rationale: Bedrock Mantle serves the Claude Messages API so same request shape; Converse API rejected

nodes.label: D-48 F20 Changeling keyboard-only persona
nodes.rationale: LLM cannot count focus order from a snapshot, so the runner Tabs to the target
